pattern: SELECT [a-z]+, COUNT\(*\) as [a-z\_\]+\_count FROM [a-z]+ LEFT JOIN [a-z]+ ON [a-z]+\.[a-z]+ = [a-z]+\.[a-z]+ GROUP BY [a-z]+

metadata.description: This rule corrects SQL queries that unnecessarily join another table when grouping and counting rows, potentially leading to incorrect results.
